limitations: All data-shard runtime code is injected with hardhat_setCode, not deployed by transactions.
PoolManager, model, hook, router and test tokens are deployed by actual local transactions.
Adaptive lexical head evaluates128group+64word+5punctuation logits per word; all 256 hidden units and two reset-after GRU128 layers and fused input lookup are evaluated.
This benchmark establishes EVM behavior and gas, not language quality or mainnet deployment readiness.

modelManifest.scope: Local only, export is not language approval
modelManifest.math: Layer1 folded word+domain+bh1 plus folded previous punctuation plus Wf features; Layer2 Wx2 new h1+bh2 and Wh2 old h2. Reset-after GRU. Three independent Keccak stages for group,word,punctuation.
